user.title: Set up GL.iNet router
user.description: Enter the router's management address and password. If Home Assistant can't reach the router's LAN side directly (e.g. it's behind its own NAT), use whatever address is reachable from this network (such as its WAN IP) and enable HTTPS if needed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the router

add_static_ip.name: Add static IP
add_static_ip.description: Set a DHCP static lease (fixed IP) for a device.

remove_static_ip.name: Remove static IP
remove_static_ip.description: Remove a device's DHCP static lease.
